## Description

Split a parent order into approximately equal child orders over a specified time interval.

## Where it may fit

Liquid markets when schedule simplicity matters and urgency is moderate; useful as an execution benchmark.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs and futures; broker execution algorithms.

## Required data

Parent order size/side, time window, market session, quotes/trades, child-order status, limits and venue rules.

## Caveats

A simple schedule ignores changing volume and alpha; completion and price are not guaranteed.
